-- Anti-Hook Environment Guard
local function lbRTgIiax()
    if debug and debug.info then
        local src = debug.info(IlTlFeUIzwbbsLOl, "s")
        if src and src ~= "[C]" then return false end
        local b_src = debug.info(IIlzCZBnkifMJ, "s")
        if b_src and b_src ~= "[C]" then return false end
    end
    return true
end

if not lbRTgIiax() then
    warn("[MoonCrypt] Environment hook detected! Execution halted.")
    return
end
